dedupe_keys.name: oscgrid comtrade conversion and validation code

description: The OscGrid team publishes Python code for processing electrical substation oscillograms. The GitHub README gives a command-line path from raw COMTRADE files to CSV signals and options for grid frequency, sampling rate, perturbation filtering and normalization. The repository tree also contains processing, model and validation directories. Source is publicly accessible under the MIT licence at no cost. The tool can prepare event traces to compare transient simulations or train protection-event classifiers around power networks; model-pypsa is a related steady-network context, not a tested direct interface. Coverage follows the OscGrid archive and its supported 50- or 60-hertz recordings. A caveat is that changing filters or trimming normal operation will alter the event distribution. Anonymized source waveforms also lack some network context. Own GitHub metadata, README and top-level tree were read without installing packages or running conversion. The Figshare oscillogram dataset is a separate record.
